name: EthniAfrica Cartes
scope: Replaces only the series video's layout (1.3.0 layout B) by a full-screen layout: the image fills the 1080 × 1920 frame, only text sits on it, every text with a dark outline, no shadow zone, nothing fitted to the networks' interface. Adds eight on-image-* tokens used by the video only. Cards, the band on cards, the seven carousel models and the images are unchanged.

acceptance.decision: The operator accepted EthniAfrica Cartes 1.4.0-proposition (the series video in full screen) on 14 October 2026 and answered its four open questions with the designer's recommendations: the same light inks on a dark outline in both themes; the heads swap inside the 300 ms card change; the series band at y 250, inside the profile grid's 3:4 thumbnail; 9:16 base maps per region for map cards whose card base map is too short.

answers.parcheminOnImage: same light inks on a dark outline in both themes
answers.cardChange: heads swap inside the 300 ms (out in 150, in in 150), images cross-fade over 300 ms
answers.shortBaseMaps: build a 9:16 base map per region from Natural Earth

acceptance.scope: Visual design reference for the series video. Cards are unchanged. The model texts are demonstration text, and the library images are web renditions too small for a 9:16 frame: production takes the full-resolution files.

acceptance.decision: The operator accepted EthniAfrica Cartes 1.3.0-proposition (series band, seven carousel models with an image proposal per card, series video model) in the Claude Design conversation on 14 October 2026, and chose video layout B, the video's own card kept inside the feed's safe zone (decision 4).
acceptance.scope: Visual design reference. Renderer integration pending (see handoff.md, « Renderer integration of 1.3.0 »); the model texts are demonstration text, not validated content, and the cards marked « image à trouver » still need their image.

videoLayoutWithdrawn.decision: Decision 4 (layout B) withdrawn: « L'image dans la vidéo doit prendre tout l'écran. Il ne doit pas y avoir de zones d'ombre comme sur les cartes des carrousels, et il ne doit pas y avoir de réajustement par rapport à la visibilité de l'écran. La vidéo prend tout l'écran, et il n'y a que le texte. » The full-screen layout is commissioned as 1.4.0-proposition.

acceptance.decision: The operator accepted EthniAfrica Cartes 1.2.0-proposition (historical atlas map: approximate zones, regional keys, 1914 partition with named territories, dotted present-day borders, period marker, collision check) in the Claude Design conversation on 12 October 2026.
acceptance.scope: Visual design reference. The renderer integrated 1.2.0 on 12 October 2026 (reference manifest, 38 accepted references, tests; see social/renderer/README.md); sample entries, positions and dates are demonstration data, not validated content.

acceptance.decision: The operator explicitly accepted EthniAfrica Cartes 1.1.0-proposition as the card design system in the production coordinator conversation.
acceptance.scope: Visual design reference; renderer integration and production acceptance checks remain pending.
